record.question: Which capital is chosen by IOC to host Olympic 2020?
record.explanation: IOC records that Tokyo was elected on 7 September 2013 to host the 2020 Games. Later postponement of the Games does not alter the host selection. Historical exam context: 2014-06 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.olympics.com/ioc/2020-host-city-election Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
